abstract: Gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTD) are a heterogenous group of disorders that arise from trophoblastic epithelium. They can follow molar pregnancy (50%), abortions (25%), normal pregnancy (22.5%), and ectopic pregnancy (2.5%) [Robert JK, Lora HE, Brigitte MR (ed) Blaustein Pathology of the Female Genital Tract 6th edn (Springer) pp. 1101-7]. Occurrence of choriocarcinoma following normal delivery presenting as an isolated bone marrow metastasis is extremely rare, and no case has been cited in the literature, to the best of our knowledge. We are reporting a case of choriocarcinoma that presented with isolated bone marrow metastasis only.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)は、栄養膜上皮から生じる異種性の疾患群である。GTDは胞状奇胎(50%)、流産(25%)、正常妊娠(22.5%)、異所性妊娠(2.5%)に続いて発生しうる。正常分娩後に絨毛癌が孤立性骨髄転移として発症することは極めて稀で、我々の知る限り文献に報告例はない。孤立性骨髄転移のみを呈した絨毛癌の症例を報告する。
